domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 道床及轨枕抵抗轨道横向位移的力。
usage_overview: 用于评价轨枕受到道床横向约束的程度。在轨枕—道砟相互作用分析中，可取指定横移量下的阻力作为评价量；所给用法采用横移2毫米时的力，这一取值不属于术语本身的限定。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Currently, track stability is fundamentally assessed by the index of track lateral resistance, which is essentially considered to be influenced by the ballast, the fastening system, and rails, with contributions of 60%, 30%, and 10%, respectively [1].
Jing et al. [16] obtained that applying the arrowhead groove frictional sleeper is able to improve lateral resistance by 7–24%.
